verdict.rationale: Docs show BugSnag tracks releases/builds and lets you filter by release to see which release an error was introduced in (docs-4, docs-12, docs-3), supporting the 'first appeared in release' half of the story. There is no evidence of a 'suspect commit' feature that pinpoints the likely causing commit for an issue. Missing for 10: suspect-commit identification, commit-level blame linking, independent corroboration of release-regression accuracy.
